caption:
Being the fastest responder in your shop creates a single point of failure.

Every owner believes personal attention wins the job. That holds right up until you're on a roof, mid-install, or asleep and the hot lead calls once.

Most service businesses still take over an hour to answer a lead. Answer within 5 minutes and your close rate can double. Neither number cares how dedicated you are.

The real fix: a follow-up system that answers before you even see the notification.

rationale: Bold-claim to-camera/text reels win hook rate for B2B right now, and the owner-as-bottleneck POV is a genuinely unclaimed contrarian angle distinct from every prior ads-vs-systems, leak, booking-friction, and cost-per-lead take already shipped.
